description: drowzeys' two-Spark launch of Tencent Hy3 295B-A21B as LibertAI's weight-only NVFP4 quantization (169 GB) on vLLM 0.24 (aeon lineage) with jethac's A4Q FlashInfer attention and an NVFP4 KV cache: TP=2, marlin MoE (the only working NVFP4-MoE path for this checkpoint on sm_121a), eager mode (upstream: CUDA graphs livelock with marlin on GB10), MTP k=2 enabled by drowzeys' MTP loader fix, and patched hy_v3 tool and reasoning parsers for Tencent's :opensource token names. Defaults follow upstream's hy3-a4q-serve.sh: 262144 context, 16 sequences, 2048 batched tokens (larger values spiked memory to a watchdog reboot upstream), GPU memory 0.85. Upstream reports (not measured here): C1 17.2 to 18.4 tok/s with MTP (+52 to 62 percent over 11.35 without), KV pool 347,888 tokens. Upstream's newer 23 tok/s lane (0xSero checkpoint on nvcr.io/nvidia/vllm:26.06 with CUDA graphs and TurboQuant KV) is not included. Known upstream quirk: no visible reasoning trace on this checkpoint. Licence: Tencent Hy Community License for the model (territorial terms apply; information only, from the checkpoint LICENSE), MIT for drowzeys' launchers. Not gated. GB10 memory correction: Per-node peak budgets utilization × 130,663,231,488-byte unified memory plus at least 8 GB for CUDA context/graphs, FlashInfer workspace, auxiliary heads and CPU/mmap buffers; 8 GB reserve, with a separate 6 GB OS floor. Absolute KV correction: 21,223,178,240 bytes per rank covers 16 simultaneous full-context requests at 16,192 tokens using the pinned cache-geometry allocation bound. Context is capped from the creator profile's 262,144 tokens to 16,192 so selected weights, this KV pool and 8 GB runtime overhead remain admissible on an idle Spark; full creator context with this concurrency does not fit. This is an offline estimate; physical acceptance remains pending. Measured peak (hardware sweep 2026-10-31T19:46:02Z, run alone, Controller node telemetry, OS included): entrypoint 125,900,378,112 and worker 125,057,146,880 bytes in use (a single post-smoke sample, so a lower bound of the steady peak); the declared peaks are the in-use bytes less the 2 GiB OS allowance, never lower than before: entrypoint 123,752,894,464, worker 122,909,663,232.
title: Hy3 295B NVFP4 A4Q MTP-2 NVFP4-KV vLLM two Sparks (drowzeys)
